note: 待 Codex 验收后锁定执行；本轮零研究模型前向、零探针拟合、零候选训练、零新敏感度计算。
main_scheme: 冻结 S1 表示、零梯度的解析式读出诊断（freeze-then-closed-form-readout）
data_fitting_declaration: 变换统计/PCA/probe 参数使用当前任务真实训练数据闭式估计；不是无数据拟合，也不是无参数拟合

D3_pca16.fit_on: current-task real-train joint ONLY (pseudo rows excluded)
D3_pca16.rule: 不因结果改变维数；低秩/秩不足逐边界记录并按预登记异常规则停止，不以 S2 准确率调整

D4_standardized56.transform: per-dim mean/std of current-task real-train joint

views.shared_training_matrix: 原 pooled_shift 规则、已保存旧类质心 + 当前新类全部真实训练 joint 生成一份共同训练矩阵；四视图共享同一矩阵与标签
views.excluded_from_transform_stats: 旧类伪特征行（仅过变换，不参与变换统计）

fixed_dim_rationale: 16 维依据最小当前真实训练规模（UWave 24 行）与共同 joint56 预先固定，而非 S1 测试性能；逐任务验证结构可行性，异常预登记

probe.type: multi-class ridge regression to one-hot targets (closed form, zero gradient)
probe.loss: ||XW + b - Y||^2 / n + lambda * ||W||^2  (bias not penalized)
probe.lambda_status: 待验收的预先固定设定；不以 S2/测试表现调参
probe.solver: center X and Y in float64, solve linear system (no explicit matrix inversion); b recovered from means
probe.targets: one-hot over all seen classes, column mapping = seen class ids ascending
probe.finite_checks: X, Y, W, b, predictions all finite; NaN/Inf stop
probe.ill_conditioning_rule: 记录条件数；秩不足/奇异即停止并报告，不换 solver、维数、lambda 或数据范围
probe.relation_to_s1_head: 与 S1 的 300 epoch L1 头不同；D1 不是 S1 保存头的性能复制；四视图同一 probe 以控制读出求解规则

per_boundary: saved old-class centroids (from S1 state package)
current new-class ALL real train joint
原 pooled_shift 规则生成共同训练矩阵（四视图共享）
validation split members of ALL seen classes (fixed accepted val split)
forbidden: 旧类真实训练数据访问（重算质心或加入 probe 训练均禁止）
未来任务的训练/验证成员在本边界参与拟合或评价
S1 已公布测试性能用于选视图/维数/lambda
未来 S3 候选结果读取
information_access.task1_validation_note: Task1 验证已用于基线早停，该事实如实记录；验证侧指标仍可用于描述性敏感度，不参与任何选择

metrics.primary: 同一 (dataset, seed, boundary) 四视图验证宏准确率的极差 range_4，展示 pp
metrics.secondary: 四视图间 SD(ddof1)；与极差不做相除
metrics.scope: 全部 15 边界 × 8 种子均报告（480 单元）；增量边界 11 个（2+2+3+4）为后续增量关联主范围，Task1 作对照

endpoint_stability.definition: 终点敏感度 S_end = range_4 at final task
endpoint_stability.stability_gate: W < B（待验收操作化提案）
endpoint_stability.report: W/B 比值 + 全部逐 seed 值
endpoint_stability.rule: 定义在看结果前固定；未过门槛降级为描述性结论并留档，不换定义

metrics.leakage_rule: 主指标仅用验证准确率构造；不使用 S1 测试性能选任何设定；不读取 S3 结果；测试侧敏感度如需只能另行预注册为描述性补充

structure_feasibility.pca_rank_check: D3 逐边界记录数值秩；秩 < 16 记录为低秩边界（照常输出，不改变维数）

revisions.count_units: 120 boundary-seed units = (3+3+4+5)x8; 480 ridge; 360 transform stage ops (120 RP matrices, 120 SVD, 120 standardizations) = 840 named fit-stage ops
revisions.validation_scope: cumulative all-seen validation rows per boundary (fixed review table), never only current-new-class validation; no test features/predictions/accuracy
revisions.low_rank: D3 always outputs 16 columns; singular values <= tol zeroed; low rank is a warning (continue); only SVD failure/non-finite stops; ridge design-matrix low rank is not a failure
revisions.legacy_pca: old Jacobi returned at most 56 columns (index slice); out_dim>56 was nominal extrapolation, never executed on UWave/CWRU; old validation covered only current new classes
revisions.s4_units: top-level unit fixed = 4 datasets; 88 points are repeated measurements (descriptive only); no 'always correlated' / 'fully decoupled' claims; complete S4 decision rule to be registered before S3 candidate results
revisions.budgets: execution asset table with full member-ID hashes, per-boundary validation counts, full SHA256; separate algorithm-parameter / diagnostic / transient / process-peak memory

numeric_rules.D2: np.random.default_rng(seed*1000+task); 56x16 float64 Gaussian / sqrt(16); center = current real-train joint float64 mean
numeric_rules.D3: float64 centering + np.linalg.svd(full_matrices=False); tol=max(n,56)*eps64*s_max; take first 16 right singular vectors; columns with s<=tol zeroed; fixed 16 output columns; record effective rank/zeroed columns/all singular values; projection matrix saved
numeric_rules.D4: float64 mean + population std, denominator std+1e-6, no extra clipping
numeric_rules.ridge: Xc=X-mean(X); Yc=Y-mean(Y); A=Xc.T@Xc/n+1e-3*I; B=Xc.T@Yc/n; W=solve(A,B); b=mean(Y)-mean(X)@W; condition number recorded; lambda never reselected
numeric_rules.seen_order: canonical ascending; argmax ties -> smallest id; macro = mean per-class recall
numeric_rules.gate: W=sqrt(mean_dataset(var_seed(S_end,ddof1))); B=SD_dataset(mean_seed(S_end),ddof1); strict W<B; B=0 -> FAIL with POSITIVE_OVER_ZERO / ZERO_OVER_ZERO ratio=null; no Infinity/NaN in JSON; endpoint means reported with ties并列 by fixed dataset order
numeric_rules.gate_scope: W<B only compares between/within dispersion of this batch's endpoint sensitivity; not pairwise separability, not predictive ability, not population extrapolation
